title: S01T05 - Establish the cross-platform release CI baseline
description: Establish automated macOS, Linux, and Windows validation for build, package, install, smoke, migration, rollback, and artifact integrity. The baseline proves technical portability without publishing a release or changing the license.
acceptanceCriteria: CI validates supported Node and operating-system combinations for build, package, install, and smoke paths.
Migration, rollback, artifact-integrity, and failure diagnostics are exercised automatically.
No public publication or license change is required.
All repository changes are captured in scoped Git checkpoint commits or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests and strict Boreal health diagnostics are run before closeout.

dirtyPathNotes: git_unavailable: cross-platform workflow, Windows smoke logic, tests, docs, and tracker state remain uncommitted because the managed session denies creation of .git/index.lock

closedReason: Cross-platform build, migration, package, install, smoke, artifact-integrity, and diagnostic validation is encoded and locally verified without publication or license changes.
